notes.title: 2/24 Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed room button displayed wrongy in Traditional Chinese and Simplfied Chinese settings.

notes.title: Fix black screen issue when the game was restarted on the hardest difficulty
notes.content:
Dear landlord,

Hello. Yesterday, after the update that allowed for custom difficulty settings, some landlords experienced a black screen when they restarted the game and entered the hypnosis mode on the hardest difficulty. We have since fixed this bug. Landlords who encountered this issue are encouraged to try again. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

Sincerely,

The Secret Camera Team

notes.title: Add difficulty setting function, Special offer is coming to an end
notes.content:
Dear Landlords,

After our lastest patch,  [b][color=white] you can now find the difficulty setting in the game settings.[/color][/b]You can enjoy the game whether you just want to relax or you prefer to have some challenge.

If you find the game enjoyable, the pictures useful, or if you think the production team is doing a great job (I said it myself), please kindly let us know. Your purchases and feedbacks are what drives us forward.

[b][color=white]Here's one more thing, the special offer will end soon, so don't miss the chance to become one of our landlords![/color] [/b]

Secret Camera Team would like to once again express our gratitude for your support and feedback.

notes.title: One-click pass function is online
notes.content:
Hello landlords,we has heard the voices of all of you. In order to let the landlords free your hands, the one-clic pass update is online. After entering the capture screen, you can see the skip button in the upper right corner, just click that, you can clear the level. Landlords, please enjoy the fun of monitoring. In addition, we are also studying the feasibility of the difficulty selection. Landlords can look forward to it a little bit.

Secret Camera team wishes all players a pleasant stay

notes.title: Fix the problem of not being able to play the game, add multiplayer CG icon
notes.content:
Hello,dear landlords, some landlords reported that after entering the game, they would be stuck in the main menu and could not play. We has tried to fix this problem as quickly as possible. We hope that all landlords can experience the fun of "Secret Camera" as soon as possible. Please contact us if you still encounter the problem of not being able to play, you can reply in this discussion thread, and we will try our best to solve the problem.(we hope you can provide the computer configuration and country/region when replying).

In addition, a multiplayer CG icon has been added to the part of the multiplayer CG, which means that it can only be unlocked after clearing multiple specific characters, we apologize for any inconvenience which caused landlords to misunderstand that the CG has not been unlocked.

notes.title: Game difficulty adjustment, English version picture error correction
notes.content:
Dear landlords, hello, after reading your suggestions, we quickly adjusted the level design, just to improve your game experience as soon as possible, please give the tenants another chance, the development team is also very grateful for your support and advice .

1. Adjust the difficulty of the game
2. Correct the picture error in English version

notes.title: 2/14 Hotfix
notes.content:
1. Adjusted game difficulty.
2. Fixed English version popping up Chinese text after game.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
《Secret Camera》 is officially released on Feb. 14 Valentine’s Day. Thank you for your support. Today you can enter the game and be one of our first early-bird landlords.

There are nine rooms in the apartment and all guests have already checked in. Please be nice to your tenants and treat them with kindness.

Unless there is anyone who misbehaved or failed into arrears of the rent. Then, as the landlord, you are entitled to do anything you want to them.

Have a nice trip as the role of landlord.

Sincerely,
Secret Camera
